scientific_integrity: The theorem is based on a complete sign-character and incidence-matrix decomposition, with exact symbolic positivity certificates for the rank transition. Finite direct Gram computations are corroboration, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The spectrum concerns only exact-degree spherical harmonics sampled with equal weights on the normalized union of short and long B_n roots. No independence or exclusive publication priority is claimed; general signed association-scheme treatments may overlap.
title: Exact all-degree spherical-harmonic spectra on the two root shells of type B
